objective: Meet Tsumugi at the shrine in the Autumn Wood, north-east across the sea
title: The Hunter's Road
summary: Tsumugi tells you what the Windward Watch guards, and what was stitched into the scroll's last seal.

steps.title: Autumn Wood
steps.sub: Red leaves, old roots, and a shrine the hunters use

say: You came across the water alone. Good. The ones who need an escort don't last in the Watch.

lines: Hunters. Seal-keepers. Five of us, once, one for each wind. Now there are three, and I'm the one who still travels.
The founders didn't only write the Scroll of Five Natures. They bound something into it, and they left the Watch to make sure it stayed bound.
A spirit stitched from five beasts. The face of a monkey, the body of a tiger, a serpent for a tail. Each one a nature.
Alone, each is a beast. Together they are hunger with a shape. It ate villages until the founders tore it apart and bound the pieces into five seals.
Kagerou has the last one. The binding. Break it, and the pieces come home to each other.
His scouts are in this wood. They weave slowly, like they're counting. A hunter doesn't wait for the count.
Break their weaves before they finish. Twice.

beats.text: Break a scout's weave before its last seal (twice)

lines: Clean. You don't hesitate when you see the seals.
...And now they know we're here. Back to back.
They were guarding something deeper in. Plans, from the way they fought to keep us out.
Your loud friend from the academy is coming at dusk. We go through the rest of them then.
